announcements.title: VerusMiner v6 is here 🎉
announcements.description: Smarter Mining power profiles, CPU-optimized builds, battery and overnight keep-alive checklist, history graphs, themes & languages. Official releases on GitHub.
announcements.content:
VerusMiner v6 is here

Thanks for mining with us. Version 6 is a big step forward for phone mining: smarter use of your CPU, better overnight reliability, clearer stats, and less battery drama when you set things up once.

What's new

Optimized mining (new Mining power)

Stop guessing thread counts. Mining power profiles map cleanly to how modern phones actually work (big.LITTLE cores, heat, and battery).

  • Balanced — everyday mining with about half your cores; good hashrate without cooking the phone
  • Performance — prefers the faster cores when your device has them, for higher hashrate when plugged in and cooled
  • Cooler — fewer cores than Balanced so the phone stays cooler and the battery lasts longer (great overnight or in warm rooms)
  • Custom — full manual control of threads and pause limits when you want to tune further

Under the hood, profiles can apply:

  • Sensible CPU thread counts for your device class
  • Core preference on phones with fast/slow clusters (Performance sticks to the quicker cores when topology is known)
  • Comfort pauses: auto-pause on high temperature or low battery, then resume after a cooldown — so mining protects the hardware instead of thrashing until it throttles

Get the most from your CPU

  • Open Device Info and run Detect CPU topology once (stop mining first). This unlocks profiles and better defaults.
  • Use the suggested miner builds for your CPU when available — optimized builds can mean better hashrate at the same heat and power.
  • After changing a profile or build, restart mining so the new settings actually apply.
  • On simple phones with only one core type, Performance behaves like Balanced — that is expected.

Battery and overnight optimization

Mining that dies when the screen turns off is usually the phone, not the pool. v6 includes Keep mining connected — a practical checklist for:

  • Battery unrestricted / don’t optimize VerusMiner (so Android doesn’t kill the miner in the background)
  • Wi‑Fi that stays on when the screen is off (or solid mobile data if you use that)
  • Power saving modes that silently cut CPU or network
  • OEM “battery savers”, game/boost modes, and auto-kill apps that break long sessions
  • Optional game/performance modes when your phone supports them for steadier clock speeds

Also built into mining itself:

  • Temperature pause: cool down instead of thermal throttling forever
  • Charge/battery pause: rest when battery is low, resume when safe
  • Cooler profile + comfort defaults for long unattended runs
  • Foreground mining service and keep-alive guidance so you know not to swipe VerusMiner away from Recents
Tip: for multi-hour or overnight sessions, plug in, pick Cooler or Balanced, run Keep mining connected once per phone model, and place the device where air can flow.

History and graphs

  • Session history with ranges (1h to 30d, custom)
  • Live charts while mining: hashrate, temperature, shares, difficulty
  • When mining stops, home can still show your last session graphs so you can review what worked

Smoother mining UX

  • Clearer home and bottom navigation
  • Accepted/hour and other metrics that are easier to read
  • Notice if the app was force-closed while mining (so you know why it stopped)
  • Refreshed onboarding and Quickstart for first-time setup

Look and language

  • Multiple themes (including community styles)
  • More languages via refreshable language packs — pull the latest from Tools / General settings

Tips after updating

  • Open Device Info → detect CPU topology (stop mining first)
  • Try Mining power: start with Balanced, use Performance when plugged in, Cooler for overnight
  • Open Keep mining connected and finish battery + Wi‑Fi items for each phone
  • Compare builds fairly: same duration, watch hashrate and temperature
  • Refresh languages/themes if you want the latest remote packs

Download and details

Official VerusMiner releases and builds are on GitHub (not the Play Store). Use the button below or open the GitHub releases page for notes and downloads.

Happy hashing — and thank you for supporting the Verus community.
